serviceParameters.label: 1. Common - Databricks Workspace Profile
serviceParameters.description: BOTH backends. Name of a profile that ALREADY EXISTS in the server's .databrickscfg (set up separately via configure-databricks.sh / README Step 3 - registering the .cdpk does NOT install credentials), e.g. DEFAULT or SP. Enter - to use the default profile.

serviceParameters.label: 2. Common - Geometry Column
serviceParameters.description: BOTH backends. Name of the column that holds the geometry, e.g. geom or shape. Required.

serviceParameters.label: 3. Common - ID Field
serviceParameters.description: BOTH backends. A unique integer id column (<= 2147483647, not a UUID), e.g. objectid. Required.

serviceParameters.label: 4. Common - Spatial Reference ID / SRID (default 4326)
serviceParameters.description: BOTH backends. EPSG code of the stored geometry, e.g. 4326 (WGS84). Enter - for the default (4326).

serviceParameters.label: 5. Common - Max Record Count (default 2000)
serviceParameters.description: BOTH backends. Maximum rows returned per page, e.g. 2000. Enter - for the default (2000).

serviceParameters.label: 6. Lakehouse - SQL Warehouse HTTP Path
serviceParameters.description: LAKEHOUSE only. The warehouse's full HTTP path, e.g. /sql/1.0/warehouses/a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8. Enter - for a Lakebase service.

serviceParameters.label: 7. Lakehouse - Table (catalog.schema.table)
serviceParameters.description: LAKEHOUSE only. 3-part Unity Catalog name, e.g. main.geospatial.us_cell_towers. Enter - for a Lakebase service.

serviceParameters.label: 8. Lakehouse - Geometry Format
serviceParameters.description: LAKEHOUSE only, optional. One of WKT, WKB, GEOJSON, GEOMETRY. Enter - to auto-detect from the column (also enter - for a Lakebase service).

serviceParameters.label: 9. Lakehouse - Time Column
serviceParameters.description: LAKEHOUSE only, optional. Timestamp column for time-aware layers. Enter - if there is none (also enter - for a Lakebase service).

serviceParameters.label: 10. Lakebase - Host
serviceParameters.description: LAKEBASE only. e.g. instance-name.database.<region>.cloud.databricks.com. Enter - for a Lakehouse service.

serviceParameters.label: 11. Lakebase - Port (default 5432)
serviceParameters.description: LAKEBASE only, e.g. 5432. Enter - for the default (5432). For a Lakehouse service, enter - too.

serviceParameters.label: 12. Lakebase - Database
serviceParameters.description: LAKEBASE only. e.g. databricks_postgres. Enter - for a Lakehouse service.

serviceParameters.label: 13. Lakebase - Schema (default public)
serviceParameters.description: LAKEBASE only, e.g. geo_demo. Enter - for the default (public). For a Lakehouse service, enter - too.

serviceParameters.label: 14. Lakebase - Table
serviceParameters.description: LAKEBASE only. e.g. cases_editable. Enter - for a Lakehouse service.

serviceParameters.label: 15. Lakebase - Enable Editing
serviceParameters.description: LAKEBASE only. Enter true to allow add/update/delete. Enter - for read-only (or for a Lakehouse service).
